items.note: Enables Ice Blast and Pegasus Strike.

items.note: Keep all game for Estoma (skips lower-level fights).

items.note: Needs Buddha's Words card (Factory Room 2); nulls Light/Dark/Nerve/Mind.

items.note: Reflects all magic, Summon Spirits, +1 Dx/level.

items.note: +1 Dx/level, Fear Torrent, Deathbound, LGT/DRK resist.

items.name: Phoenix
items.note: Nullifies Light/Dark; add non-Fire Skill Card.

items.note: Needs Rune Monument card (Factory Room 6); nulls all magic/status, Thunder Baptism, +1 Dx/level.

items.note: Needs Avatar card; resists nearly all attacks, nulls Light/Dark/Nerve/Mind, +1 Dx/level.

items.name: Lucifer
items.note: Needs Morning Star card (or Michael mutation); unlocks Armageddon.
